title: rulac kingii
intro: Rulac kingii, commonly known as Rauvolfia tetraphylla, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and hypertension, due to its sedative and vasodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Raulac kingii include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Raulac kingii include indole alkaloids, particularly reserpine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
